summary: Six distinct operating sponsors meet the criteria for Phoenix retail single-asset closed acquisitions between 2025-09-01 and 2026-08-31 with sizes $6–$18M. These are Birch Point 6 Capital (R2245), Birch Park 5 Capital (R6968), Birch Square 4 Capital (R8710), Birch Park 3 Capital (R1638), Birch Square 2 Capital (R7815 with U-R7815-1), and Birch Square 1 Capital via SPV Birch Square 7 Capital (R2005 mapped to parent with contact from R1077). Duplicates and non-qualifying records (brokers/managers, portfolio totals, out-of-range sizes, non-Phoenix markets, office assets, announced bids, outdated or non-qualifying contacts, or sources published after 2026-08-31) were excluded per evidence from the cited sources.
limitations: Contact recency relies on stated verification dates and the effective date of team-page updates; no additional confirmation beyond supplied sources.
SPV-to-parent consolidation assumes the executed ownership schedule mapping provided; only the parent’s contact data is used.
Records published after the 2026-08-31 cutoff (e.g., S-R9716) were not considered; additional qualifying activity may exist but is not evidenced in-packet.
Where duplicate base records exist for the same sponsor (R2431/R1077), selections are deduped to one operating sponsor entry.
